def card(work):
    gaps = [{'readings_diverge': False, 'risky': False, 'plausible': 'use 9:16 like the last reel'}, {'readings_diverge': True, 'risky': False, 'question': 'Arabic or English captions?', 'options': ['Arabic', 'English', 'both', 'none']}, {'readings_diverge': False, 'risky': False, 'invent': True}]

def card(work):
    cases = ['ok1', 'ok2', 'missing input', 'very long', 'harmful', 'disputed']
    base = dict(zip(cases, [1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0]))
    win = dict(zip(cases, [1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1]))
    reg = dict(zip(cases, [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1]))
    r = {'win': ab_keep(base, win), 'regress': ab_keep(base, reg), 'tiny': ab_keep({'a': 1}, {'a': 1})}
    save(work, 'ab.json', r)
    return [eq('win without regressions kept', r['win'][0], True), eq('higher score but a regression -> rejected', (r['regress'][0], r['regress'][1]['regressions']), (False, ['harmful'])), eq('too few cases', r['tiny'][0], False), truth('edge cases included', {'missing input', 'harmful'} <= set(cases))]

def card(work):
    doc = 'DOC ' * 500
    bad = lambda ts, q: f'time={ts} user=ali\nQuestion: {q}\n{doc}'
    good = lambda ts, q: f'{doc}\nQuestion: {q}\n(time={ts})'
    pb = prefix_len(bad('10:00', 'a'), bad('10:01', 'b'))
    pg = prefix_len(good('10:00', 'a'), good('10:01', 'b'))

    return [truth('timestamp on top kills the cached prefix', pb < 20, pb), truth('document first keeps it', pg >= len(doc), pg), truth('question after the document', good('t', 'q').index('Question') > good('t', 'q').index('DOC'))]
